children: FlyQuest’s implied win probability in Polymarket’s "Game 3 Winner" submarket for the "LoL: FlyQuest vs. Shopify Rebellion - LCS Playoffs" event jumped from 67% one hour earlier to 91.5%, a 24.5 percentage-point increase. According to ChainCatcher, the sharp move suggests a sudden market reaction to breaking news affecting the matchup.

title: FlyQuest Odds Surge in Polymarket LCS Playoff Game 3 Market
